author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
[PANTHER:PTN000144386](https://pantree.org/node/annotationNode.jsp?id=PTN000144386)
[PANTHER:PTN000172504](https://pantree.org/node/annotationNode.jsp?id=PTN000172504)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Arg (D. melanogaster, O76895) for PTN000144386
Ass (D. melanogaster, O97069) for PTN000172504

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous propagation of GO:0000050 urea cycle
D. melanogaster and most arthropods don’t have a functional urea cycle (PMID:40081835)

@pgaudet 
Maybe a taxon constrain could be added to the GO term.
title: PAINT issue: PTN000144386 and PTN000172504
